title: The Lancashire Creamery Farm Shop Apple Sugar Doughnut 100ml Shortfill
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Apple Sugar Doughnut captures the comforting flavour of a freshly baked Doughnut filled with warm Apple compote and dusted with fine Sugar. The golden, buttery Doughnut base delivers a soft and slightly crisp bakery note, while the Apple filling brings a balance of natural sweetness and gentle tartness. A final sprinkle of Sugar ties the flavours together, creating an indulgent and satisfying dessert vape. With a 70% VG / 30% PG formulation, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, making it ideal for high-powered vape kits, mods, sub-ohm tanks, and low-resistance coils. The thick VG content ensures dense vapour production while delivering consistently rich flavour. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for crafting rich, indulgent dessert flavours. Their shortfill collection blends classic bakery, custard, and milkshake profiles, delivering smooth, full-bodied vapes for those who enjoy creamy, sweet treats.
